summary: Service lane with homes 3-10 m from the kerb along its length.
reasons: Residents' cars and driveways line it

best_section.where: Gap between two houses on the south side, about 150 m along the lower lane

drivers.seclusion: Houses adjoin the lane on the south side, with dwellings 3 m at both ends of the best gap and 14 m opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lower service lane with little verge; a few cars park at the western end.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local lane, parallel to the main Highland Terrace carriageway.
drivers.convention: Residents park on it; 2P resident-permit signs apply.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of the section's ends
Steep: about 9% grade at best section
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover along the north edge, partial shade from the east and west.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is open to through traffic
